entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda Mwari zvakare nemumwe mukana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukana wokuti utsvake nyasha pamberi paMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukana wokuti kana usina kunzwika nezuro, nhasi unzwike pamberi paMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pano ndoMwari panoda kuti mu Gentile anamate. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari akati, “Budai muma kere...? [Congregation says, ‘muma kereke.’] Bhabhironi radii...?” [Congregation says, “rawa.”] Tiendepi? Tiendepi? Havana kutiudza pekuenda kunze kwe Spoken Word chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka hama zhinji dzakabuda pa Chechi panapa dzikaenda dzikanotsvaga dzimwe church dze Message dzemu-dzemu Harare. Ndobva vanomuwana ikoko? [Congregation says, “ah-ah/kwete.”] Vakatoona kuti pano pavakabva vachiramba kudya tsuro nenguruve, vachiita nharo dzekuti toda kudya tsuro nenguruve, zvaive nani pane zvavakazonosangana nani...? [Congregation says, “nazvo.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavadii...? [Congregation says, ‘ngavanzwe,’] zvinotaura chii...?” [Congregation says, “Mweya.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vamwe vakatiza barika pano, vakasvika kuno paridzirwa nevafundisi vakanga vaine ma girlfriends emuma Avenues, sixteen. Hm. Iye kwakuzotaura oga kuti, “Havazi sixteen, ini ndinoziva seventeen.” Handi’munoona zvaakanga achitaura iye ari oga? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndokuenda kuno porofitirwa nevanhu vakanga vaine ma girlfriends hobho. Ndokuenda kunodzidziswa nema teacher akanga aine ma girlfriends e secret, asi vabva pano vachitiza ba...? [Congregation says, “barika.”] Dzidza paku beha-vha [to behave—ED] kwemapenzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ngatizvibatei mukati meShoko raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pano patakauya panaapa ndipo patinogona ku achiever zvirongwa zvatinazvo zvo...? [Congregation says, “zvose.”] Ukauya panaapa nehunyengeri, “Hasha dzaMwari dziri pamusoro pavose vanobata zvokwadi yake mukudii...? [Congregation says, ‘mukusarurama,’] mukusarurama.” Hatikuzive, hatikunongedzere, tinongokuparidzira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Asi iwe mwoyo wako unoudii...? [Congregation says, “unouziva.”] Dai zuva ranhasi ratawana mumwe mukana iri, rava zuva raunoenzana naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Enzanisa hupenyu hwako nani...? [Congregation says, “naMwari/Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Iti, “Baba ndiri boka riya revaya vanoshoropodza, ndiri boka reuya asingatende, ndiri boka reuya anouya mu Church kuzotapa, ndiri boka reuya anouya mu Church kuzoshora. Asi zuva rimwe nerimwe randinobva mu Church imomo, Mweya waMwari unenge wandipomera mhosva. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Zviri zvanhasi, gadziranai neni Jehovah. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndoda kubuda muno ndiri mwana wenyu chai...? [Congregation says, ‘chaiye.’] Zvinobva pamwo...? [Congregation says, ‘pamwoyo,’] ndichiti ndava waKristu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hanzi zvinobva payi...? [Congregation says, “pamwoyo.”] Ehe, ndichiti ndava waani...? [Congregation says, “waKristu.”] Waakufamba, “Holy, holy to the Lord, God Al...?” [Congregation says, “Almighty.”] Manheru ano iti Mwari ndipeiwo Mweya Mutsvene. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda double portion manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda nyasha dzebasa idzva. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda nyasha dzekuno deliver. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda nyasha dzekukunda hurwere. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda nyasha dzekuti ndive nembereko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari ndoda nyasha dzekuti ndinyatsoziva kuti ndiri panzvimbo yakaiswa Zita naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Panzvimbo chii...? [Congregation says, “tsvene,”] tsvene, yakanzi naMwari mukauya ipapo ndinokuitirai zvamunoda zve...? [Congregation says, “zvese.”] Ichocho chauri kuda ichocho, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] panzvimbo tsvene Mwari vakati ndinosangana nani...? [Congregation says, “newe.”] Hatisimukei manheru anhasi. ([Blank spot on tape—ED] …ni ndoda), ndoda, (ndoda), ndoda, Ndoda Mwari Muyamuri (Baba) Muri wangu, Ndakatengwa (Ini) neRopa raIshe, (Hona) Ndava (va) wenyu chose.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hatipindei mukuteura tose. [Congregation enters into Pentecostal Prayer] ...am happy…[Song leader sings inaudibly—ED] (At the cross) At the cross, at the cross Where I first saw the light, And the burden of my heart rolled away, (Rolled away) It was there by faith I received my sight, And now I am happy all the day! (At the cross) At the cross, at the cross Where I first saw the light, (Oh) And the burden of my heart rolled away, (Rolled away) It was there by faith, (Oh) I received my sight, And now I am happy all the day! (Oh, at the cross) At the cross, at the cross (Oh) Where I first saw the light, (Oh) And the burden of my heart rolled away, (Rolled away) It was there by faith, (Oh) I received my sight, (Oh) And now I am happy all the day!

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba wedu tinokutendai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vaAbrahama, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari vaJakobho, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari vaDhavhidha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba, Mwari webarika, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] God of polygamy, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mdimo wasitembo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinokutendai nenyasha dzenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nekuimbirwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinotenda ne worship, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda neShoko razuro, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinotenda nenyasha dzekufamba kuva pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari tinokukudzai manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinotenda kuva panzvimbo tsvene, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuva panzvimbo yamakaisa Zita renyu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuva panzvimbo yamunosangana nemutadzi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuva panzvimbo yamunodaira muteuro yose. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekudaro Baba, vese vakazvitakura ngavabatsirwe nenyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanonoka Baba, ngavasunungurwe, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muZita raJeso. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vari kunetseka nemitoro mumisoro yavo, poresai Baba wakarurama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tenzi makanaka tatarisa kwamuri musimboti wedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tenzi makanaka chitiitirai nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pakuguma kwekushumaira kwezuva ranhasi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] toda kufamba nenyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tichidzokera kwatabva, tiruramisei, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] titungamirirei, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tibatsirei Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinzvenge tsaona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari makanaka tinoisa Jehovah wakarurama vese vasara kudzimba. Tichinoyanana navo, ngativasimudzireiwo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tive mumweya mumwe chete, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiri kunyengeterera August yedu pindirai, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tiri kunyengeterera gore resanduko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinoziva kuti zvinoitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mabasa anowanikwa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] hapana baren womb mu Isiraeri, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] status inochinja, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinokunda vavengi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tichawana pekuvaka, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tichavaka Jerusarema, Home of the Bride. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba makati, “Munozarura hwindo redenga kusvika tinoshaya pokuisa maropafadzo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chivai nevatsvene vari Britain ne Amereka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chivai Baba wakanaka navo kugadzirira kwavanoita August. August tiitirei nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiuyai mumba muno Baba wakanaka mubate mumwe nemumwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vayenzi Baba, vanobata zvokwadi iyi nepfungwa, Baba, vari papfungwa yekudzokera kumasure, tishandei tose, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kubuda muno tabatikana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kubuda muno takunda makuhwa, takunda zvitaurwa taurwa, takunda zvinyeyewa nyeyewa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndinokutendai Jehovah wangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chipindai mumharidzo yamasikati ano, Baba tigobuda munomu mwoyo yedu yakasimudzirwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tinotenda negohwo, Jehovah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tatarisa kurima kwegore rino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nehutano, kuchengeta kwamunoita vana vedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinotenda nechokufuka nechokudya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nepekugara nechekufambisa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nemweya wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kudzwai namatwai nekusingapere, taikumbira izvi nokutenda, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tigare hedu tese pasi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wedu chaiwo kuva mukati meimba yaMwari nemusi we Sunday kudai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka... Mufaro wedu chaiwo kuva muimba yaMwari pazuva ranhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. Totenda Mwari chaizvo, tawana ma service akanaka chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I think this is the best service in Zimbabwe today. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] As far as praise and wor...? [Congregation says, “worship,”] worship is concerned. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: I don’t think you could go anywhere and get any-any better. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda Mwari chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. It was a wonderful service of praise, wonderful service of worship. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tarumbidza Mwari, tatenda Mwari. Munomu ndofunga kunyangwe vasingagoni kutamba vachadzidzira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unotozongowanawo mazunguziro aunozviitawo, [Congregation laughs—ED] kana wanga uri munhu uya ari stiff, handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Unodzimara ukawana mazunguziro aunozviitawo. Inzira yekutenda ani...? [Congregation says, “Mwari,”] Mwari, handi’moona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vazhinji vedu tinofunga kuti aah, maybe kutambira Mwari hayi-hatifaniri—No. In the house of the Lord... Vanhu vanoenda kubhawa kunokanganwa nhamo dzavo, kunoenda mumatondo kunoputa mbanje, kukanganwa nhamo dzavo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: But munhu anopinda mu Church akasuwa. Agoimba, agoparidzirwa akasuwa kusvika abuda akangodaro. Kokutenda kwako kuripi? Zvokwadi vanhu vakaisa kutenda mudoro vava nani kune vakaisa kutenda muna Mwari? Ndosaka kana uchiuya pano nedambudziko, huya ufare. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Wasiya kumba kusina kumira zvakadii...? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Ehe, huya ufare muimba yaani...? [Congregation says, “yaMwari,”] yaMwari. Nekuti pauno dzokera kumba kunenge kwanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It’s a promise. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hanzi ukarumbidza Mwari, paunodzokera kumba ikoko kunenge kwanaka. Nekuti pauri kurumbidza paya paya, nziyo dziya dziya, dzese chiporofita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro watinawo ndehwa Je...? [Congregation says, “ndehwa Jeso.”] Unozosvika mufaro iwoyo wagadzirwa, wavawo kumba kwakowo futi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, handi’moona, ehe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana usinganzwe zvakanaka... Imagine yesterday, I came here, I was half dead with tiredness. I’ve been tired now for almost about two to three weeks. But kana Mwari vapindira munyaya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndaitova nepfungwa dzokuti aah, takatozvi discusser kumba ndikati akomana ma service aya eku Gweru aya tombofanira kuenda but ndendiripo hangu, ndombogara ndichinzwa vamwe vachidii...? Vachiparidza. Nokuti unenge wakunzwa kuti nyama dzaakudaira, ha’moona. But wangomira apo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ayihwa, inenge yaimwe nyaya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukangomira ipapo unoita fanika, unozonzwa-uno—Imagine, ndopaunoona kuti i anointing. Unopedza kuparidza woto feeler pressure, than zvawanzwa uchita...? [Congregation says, “uchitanga.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Wotoenda mu office umu, kukurukura kukanganwa. Paunosvika kumba manje, zvobva zvakudhonora. Annointing inenge yakudii manje...? [Congregation says, “yadzikama/yakusiya.”] [Apostle chuckles—ED] Wobva wachizvambarara manje. Like yesterday, I don’t even remember what I dreamt. Ndarara sendakafa. “How sweet and good is the sleep of a labouring man.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndafarira kupinda mumachira kudaiwo, kufa. [Apostle claps once—ED] Ndamuka na exactly six thirty-nine. Dzanga dza twenty-one minutes to seven, ndopandapepuka. Kubva ndichinorara, handi’moona. Unongoenda uchibva wangofira ipapo kamwe chete.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Haurote, haurumwe ne mosquito, hauitwe sei, haumharwe nenzunzi, hauzvizivi. [Congregation laughs—ED] Nda’ndakafa zvekuti dhuu. Zvokuti nda’ndichifunga kuti ah kuseni unomuka usingambogoni, ah. “They that wait upon the Lord…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda Mwari chaizvo nenyasha dzavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It’s a service that when... ukaipedza, handitika, aah unenge watogomera, nekuti inenge ichinakidza.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Zvandotaura ndikati ah, kana ndichiuya kuno kuGweru ne benz yangu, handimbofari because journey yacho inondiitira chii...? Pfupi. [Congregation laughs—ED] Mota inenge ichinakidza zvisingaiti, zvekuti by the time I get here nde’ndakutoti ah manje vakomana, heh. Manje ini nda-dai nda’chienda kuBhuruwayo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: [Congregation laughs] Chinenge chichifamba kuti... [Apostle imitates the sound his car makes—ED] Chinonakidza mu road umu zvokuti unosvika uri-u-usinga-ha—unenge wangogarawo wakazvinetera but iyo haina chainowedzera pakuneta. Inonakidza zvekuti dhuu. Saka ndo complain yangu all the time kuti the moment we use this car, we will be enjoying our drive until we get there, and we will be very angry when we are there.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Because—And ndaka-ndakavaudza tichisimuka, ndichivaudza ta—ndikavaudza ta’amu Kadoma. Taakusvika tose, everyone wandandinaye akasuwawo nekuti mota yaidii...? [Congregation says, “yainakidza.”] Ndikati, “Ko Mai Tito ka?” Zvikanzi, “Haa shuwa, dai ta’tichisvika hedu kana pa Joburg apo.” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handi’muri kuzviona. Ndozvinoita service yakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana une service yakanakaka, inokunakidza zvekuti you can’t wait for the next one. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You can’t wait to get the next to the service again. Ino inopera wakutoti aah, dai tasvika kune imwe. Saka ma brothers, lets really pray for our August Convention. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kuti iite Convention yakanaka chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] ehe. Ngaive Convention yakanaka chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yakanyanyisa nekuna...? [Congregation says, “nekunaka,”] nekunaka.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Zvikuru, toda kuti Mwari vatidzidzise Shoko ravo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanoimba ngavarege kutirasira pasi, vati compo-zere [to compose—ED] nziyo dzinonakidza, ha’moona. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vaite concentrate, va porishe [to polish up—ED]. Hama dzaakugona kuridza hudimbwa but there is always a notch higher. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] There is always a no...? [Congregation says, “notch higher.”] Ehe, aim for perfection. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handitika hama, ehe, ha’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndaiona ma rehearsals e-ayiitwa na Michael Jackson. Anga achibuda pa Movie Magic 2, vachingotaura. Yanga iri period yema rehearsals ake. Kwanga kune almost three or four. The man would rehearse. He would rehearse even a dance. Ndosaka ndichiti haikona kumhanya kuisa munhu panaapa anenge asina practice iri enough. Anokukanganisira zvinhu zvakawanda, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ukaita practice, you deliver a perfect thing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The good thing about delivering a perfect thing, it means you value your listeners. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] They will always a-appreciate a perfect thi...? [Congregation says, “thing,”] thing. But ukauya ukati kanyira pano, to’ona sekuti hauna kuti remekedza. Wauyirei usiri rea...? [Congregation says, “ready,”] ready. There is nothing as irritating as bad music, munzeve umu. It’s like bad food on a tummy. It’s like a smell on a nose.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndozvakaita bad mu...? [Congregation says, “music.”] Inokutsamwisai mese. Munongoti, “Ha iwe, nyarara!” [Congregation laughs] Ha’moona. Hamusati mamboona kuti munhu ukaimba zvakaipa vanhu vanopopota? “Iwe shut up mhani. Heyi, heyi, heyi, shut up! Ibva apo, ibva apo!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Kana kune chinhu chino provoker, i music. But music can urge you to be nice. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inokusunungura zvakanaka. It provokes all emotions in our bo...? [Congregation says, “body,”] in our body. Iriko music inongokuti haaaa! Muchaziva nziyo yakambouya yaiimbwa, pane imwe television station yakanga yavhurwa, yaiimbwa neumwe mukadzi. Ayiimba i-iri yechishona. [Apostle starts singing the song—ED] “Ndakaenda kuMhondoro. Iyoo iyoyo. Howowowowowo.” Muchaiziva nziyo iyo? [Congregation laughs—ED] Kana kune nziyo yainditsamwisa pasi pano. [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Ndaishaya kuti kuimba here? Vadzidza here chord dzacho? Handiti.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: How can a—How can somebody put that one as a record. [Apostle imitates the artists singing—ED] Achiimba achiti, [Apostle imitates the artists singing—ED] mukadzi wacho. Mukadzi wacho zvaanenge akaita, vanhu vacho unongoona kuti ha! What’s wrong with these guys? Ha’moona. But music, God made it accompany us. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pane worship and sacrifice panoda mu...? [Congregation says, “music,”] music, handi’maona. Saka, we want brothers to really do good practice and-and-and-and give us wonders. Handi’moona, ehe. Pa…pa…pa Convention yedu. Hatiigadzirirei chai...? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Nhaika vanhu vaMwari, handi’moona, ehe.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka tichiimba hedu, Bring them in, Brother Mupa ngavaunze mwana wavo. Doctor Mupa vaane mwana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ayihwa tinoona manana—munana ya Jehovah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! Hanti, ehe. Ngavauye havo Brother Mupa nejaya ravo, Bezel. Chorus Bring them in, bring them in, Bring them in from the fields of sin; Bring them in, bring them in, Bring the little ones to Jesus. (Bring them in) Bring them in, (Bring them in) Bring them in, (In) Bring them in from the fields of sin; Bring them in, bring them in, Bring the little ones to Jesus.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, kamwana kakanaka chaizvo aka. Saka nda’achivayeuchidza kuti muzukuru wangu akanaka. [Apostle and Congregation laughs—ED] Totenda Mwari chaizvo na Bezelel. Very beautiful boy. We really enjoyed having him, we also, among us, kumba uko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda Mwari neropafadzo rakadai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] I never could foresee a day Brother Mupa would have a baby. Saka tinotenda Mwari chaizvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatinyengeterei.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba mufaro wangu kubata mwana uyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari makarurama hatina kumbenge takazvitarisira senguva iyo ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taitoona Baba roora chairo riri impossible. Now, like Jacob said to Joseph, “I never thought I could see your face. Now, I have your seed.” Lord, we thank thee for this boy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Father may he be a bez-a-a-a-a blessing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Bezel ngaakure kuva sababa vake namai vake. Baba namai, ngavachiramba vari mukunamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tenzi makanaka, mukomana uyu agorerekera kune zvechitendero. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Munzvengesei kumweya yemadzinza. Ukaendawo ku Nigeria…[Apostle sings a Nigerian song demonstrating a Nigerian dance style—ED] My God is good oh Eh, my God is good oh Eh, God is good oh… Ehe. Hee, God is good oh ye…[Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka munhu nemunhu ngaarege kushora zverudzi rwake. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatirumbidzei Mwari nerudzi rweduwo zvakare handiti. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kuti hama dzekuAmereka dzikauya dzikaona tichiimba nziyo dzedu vanozvi importer kuenda nazvo kwaani…? [Congregation says, “kwavo,”] seku importer kwatakaitawo tanakidzwa nedzani…? [Congregation says, “nedzavo.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Pano ticharamba tichidi…Tichadzimara tikanyora hymn book ye…? [Congregation says, “yedu.”] Hymn book iyoyo muchaiona kuti vana vedu vachasara vachiyidii…? [Congregation says, “vachiyiimba.”] Vachasara vachiyishandisa hymn book iyoyo. Vana vedu vachasara vachishandisa hymn book iyoyo iyo, vasisatombozive kuti dzakaimbwa nani. Yavanenge vari…Toda kumeka shuwa kuti pano kana paine revival muchipfuva, mweya mumwe chete wakapinda mune vakanyora ma hymn book revival yaitika munguva dzaani…? [Congregation says, “dzavo,”] kuri kuparidza kwemutumwa wa–wenguva yavo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: John Wesley anga ari mutumwa wechi six, ku Philadelphia. Akaparidza pa–Ndopakabuda vana “Amazing Grace” ava. Ndopakabuda vana–vana, [Apostle sings briefly—ED] “Tsitsi dzinondishamisa…” Ndopavakanga vachinyora vana John Wesley vachinyora nziyo dzamunofarira imimi. Aive mutumwa wechinomwe. Ko zvatakapihwawo mutumwa wenguva yedu hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Sei muMwenga musina music, yemuno medu muno umu?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vanhu vanofanira kuita hymn book ravo rokutanga ndisu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] We must introduce a new hymn book in the Bride. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka mukaona, we had to sit down kuti titsvage worship, toita worship yakadii…? And we are rejoicing…[Inaudible 01:04:05] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nokuti tanga tangogamuchira zvinongo handwa [to hand over-ED] over kuchechi kwana Brother Billy Paul, handi’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tongogamuchira zvinoitwa kuchechi kwa Brother Peary Green. Saka ivo ndovakaita sei? Can’t we do something here? Ndosaka isusu vanhu vaMwari isusu, vana vaMwari makaropafadzwa kuti vatungamirirwe muzvinhu zvavanoita vanhu ava. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hapana munhu anofanira kuti anetseke kana chinhu chauya chichirumbidza Mwari chiri mumweya wakanaka, chiine mwoyo wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinofanira kupinda mukurumbidza Mwari te…? [Congregation says, “tese.”] Ndosaka mukaona vana “Ngatijekerwe” vaya, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa, inziyo dzakanaka dziya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. [Apostle sings “Ngatijekerwe.”—ED] Ngatijekerwe (ngatijekerwe) Ngatijekerwe (ngatijekerwe) Ngatijekerwe (ngatijekerwe)…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handi’muri kuzviona hama, handi’moona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inziyo yakanaka chaizvo iya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona. Zvokuti unenge uchinyatsoona kuti murume uyo ka uyu, ari kuti dai tanga tajekerwa nokuti vanenge vasina kujekerwa muChechi vakawanda chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Vari kungotevera, gundamusaira. Kungouya chete kuzongogara muChechi. Ndosaka isusu vanhu vaMwari, isusu muno umu, we are the Church of the first borns. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tofanira ku introducer zvinhu zvinyowani nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Early church structure, akaitanga ndiani? [Congregation says, “tisu.”] Marriage and divorce, vakaitanga ndivanani? [Congregation says, “tisu.”] Way of worship yatiri kutanga iyi ichateedzerwa nevanhu ve…? [Congregation says, “vese.”] Hakuna chatisingatange. Hymn book yedu tichaita nyowani futi ndisu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukaona kwaakuitwa ma convention anywhere kunenge kwaakuitwa, vanenge vachiteedzera isusu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiri Kereke yematangwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: I right yevatsvene iyoyo iyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndo right yevatsvene yakazara chaiyo chaiyo iyoyo. Toda kutanga…Tais–ta zvinhu zvedu isusu pana apa taropafadzwa, tavaka chechi dzedu…Iyo chechi ino inofanira ku improve-wa [to be improved—ED] zvakanyanya fani. Tinofanira kupaza kumasure uku, topaza kuno ku stage kunoku. Muchaona kana tai–taigadzira. Stage inenge yachinja ku front uku. Taane dzimwe pfungwa dziri kuenderana nenguva yatiri kurarama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Toda kuti irebe chechi inosvika kunze chaiko chaiko uku, kutumiti utu, tuduku utu. Then toirova zvakanaka mukati munomu manje umu, kuyigadzira zvakanaka muno. Zvokuti kacho ka–patinenge…Toda dance floor, pekuti vanhu vakanakidzwa vakada kutamba vanota…? [Congregation says, “vanotamba.”] Pane ma instruments pavo vo…? [Congregation says, “voga.”] Pano imba ma item vachimirawo pa stage yavo voga. Ehe. Muparidziwo pratfomu [platform—ED] yake o…? [Congregation says, “oga,”] oga. Zvinoitwa nevakadiwa naMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iropafadzo revakadiwa nani iri…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”] Ha’moona.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka isu tichiti vanhu vaMwari, toda kusiya inonzi footprints on the sands of time. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tabva pano vana vedu havambofa vakayemura imwe chechi futi, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nekuti yedu haina chainenge ichisvo…? [Congregation says, “ichisvorwa.”] Handidi kuti mwana wangu akure achiti, “Nhai Baba, kuchechi kwana nhingi kwakanaka kudarika kwedu ende vanonamata kutidarika,” isu tiri panzvimbo yakanzi naMwari ndoyandinoda? Inofanira kuva nenziyo nyowani, magatare manyowani, chechi dzakanaka.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hatifaniri kuva vanhu vane complex. Muri kuona kuti complex muri kuyikoka. Makabva nayo Gogwe. [Congregation laughs—ED] Buhera! KwaChurumhanzu, kwaChivi, ndokwamakabva ne complex iyi until you underestimate yourself. Hauchisiri mwana wekwaChurumhanzu nowokwaChivi iwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makapinda Mweya wakabva kudenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makapinda Mweya wedenga mauri imomomo hama. Chatiri kutaura ichi chiporofita choMwenga. Hanzi, “Vanoziva Mwari wavo they shall do e…?” [Congregation says, “exploits.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona vanhu vaMwari, zvese izvi toda kuti timise structure dzakanaka. Muchechi tinenge tine hymn book yedu tichiimba. Toti, “Hymn book yedu yepano, hymn 10. Hymn book yoMwenga wese, hymn 35.” Handi’moona zvatinenge tichitaura? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Hymn book ye Methodist, hymn 46.” Dzinenge dziripo dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose.”] Unenge wakadziisa apa pako apa, toziva kuti pano apa pakapfuura revival. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vedu vachisara vachiteera imomo. Vana Munesu ndomavanopinda namo imomomo. Vana Tito, vana Bati, vana Gari, ndomavanopinda namo imomo vachiparidzirana.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndiri kukumbirisa vanhu vaMwari, ino ndiyo nguva yekunyengetera ino hama, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari achinje status yaani…? [Congregation says, “yangu,”] usiye wawana chekunongedzera kuvana vaani…? [Congregation says, “vangu.”] Ndosaka makaona baba vese vaishingaira, pastor vese vanoshingaira kuti muChechi mavo ngamuite vanhu vanoimba, ngamuite vanhu vanoridza magatare, ngamuite vanhu vanovaka chechi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Iyoyi chechi ino tikada kuyivaka iyi, it’s a matter yekuti tikati tinoda kuti inge yava ready, in one month, tikangoti ndozvatiri kuda, ndizvozvo. Zvinodii…? [Congregation says, “zvinoita.”] Nekuti panaapa mari iri…? [Congregation says, “iripo.”] Anovaka wacho ari…? [Congregation says, “aripo.”] Labour yacho iri…? [Congregation says, “iripo.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kungoti Brother Satiya huyai pano. Tovapa ma brother anokanya dhaka nevamwe vose, taakutoenda…vakutofambira mapran [plan—ED] Taaku drawer kuzasi uku, yaakutorohwa foundation.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: In a weeks’ time tetapaza kwese uku tawedzera uku. Tatorova… [Apostle makes a sound to demonstrate working with speed—ED] …gwa gwa gwa gwa gwa gwa gwa gwa gwa gwa, tawedzera chimwe chi portion chiri half chechi ino iyi chichienda kumashure uko. Taakurova magirazi, ma–magetsi. Kana taakurova magetsi, Chiundura ndobasa raani…? [Congregation says, “ravo.”] Anouya achi chizera, achirova magetsi, achirova, mamwe achiuya mu side umu, kuitira kuti kana wa–chiverenga unongobatidza kudaiwo wakutoverenga uri pa side pako apa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Torova purupiti yogadzirwa zvakanakanaka, ha’moona. Touya muchechi mune ma tiles akanaka. Rino igore resanduko. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Complex inokonzerwa nekwaunobva, nepaunorara, nechaunopfeka, nechaunodya. Pane nzvimbo dzekuti ukapinda mavari uno–uchingopindamo unoisa ruoko muhomwe usingadi. Nzvimbo yacho inokutu…? [Congregation says, “inokutuma.”] Unongoona wangodaiwo, nyangwe mari usina. Unongoona va–munhu wese vaka–vanenge varimo vanenge vakangoisa maoko muhomwe, wongoona kuti rwangu rwunongoramba ruri panze sei. [Congregation laughs—ED] Newewo watoisawo ako maoko muhomwe. Confidence dzinouya ne environment.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Manje pano vanhu vaMwari tine chinangwa, tine vision, tine chatoda kuzadzikisa. Mwari ngavatiitire nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vedu vatiri kuzvara, kana tikasawana kana munhu watinowedzera kana mumwe chete, ngavava Chechi yegore rinodii… ramangwana. Ndosaka mukaona, isusu ndisu vana baba isu. Ndisu vana baba veChechi dzino idzi. Hakuna vamwe vana baba vanopfuura isusu. Tiri kuzvara vana vatoda kuti varambe vari pano paChechi pedu pano. Hatidi kuti vana vedu varambe vaine complex yeKereke yaMwari iyi. Saka zvatiri isu vana baba isusu, ngatigadzirei pfuma isu pachedu. Ngatiitei zvinhu, a body of work.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mwari akatadza kutidaira pa change of status, zvinongoreva kuti muChechi manga musina anonama…? [Congregation says, “anonamata,”] nekuti kuda kwaMwari ndekwekuti, “Come. In blessing I will bless thee…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda kuona munhu mumwe nemumwe achiropafadzwa, mumwe nemumwe. Uchiroora mukadzi, woita muchato kwawo, muchienda kunogara imba yenyu yakanaka. Muchiuya paChechi pano apa nemotokari yenyu, muChechi tichiimba takasununguka sevana veIsraeri, zvavaiita Mwari wavo avaitira nya…? [Congregation says, “nyasha.”] Mwari dzoreredzai kunamata. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka vana vemunhu ane integrity, vakasara panyika pano, hanzi vanosara vachiropafadzwa iye angori afa ka…? [Congregation says, “kare.”] Hatidi kuti Chechi ino imire. Ko vana Tamandani vanonamatira kupi? Vazukuru vangu. Chokwadi vazukuru vangu vanononamata kuBherevhedhiya? Ndomuka chipoko zve. Vazukuru vangu vaende kunonamata ku–ku–ku–ku–kuHirusaidi uko kana kuMebhoraini? Ko, akamboita kuti vave pano ndiMwari wekuMebhoraini? [Congregation says, “ah-ah.”] NdiMwari wekuHirisaidhi? [Pastor Dabwara says, “kwete.”] Vakanzi vave pano naMwari upi? [Congregation says, “wepano.”] Ndinganzwa Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka baba vese vanogona kutaura zvavanoda pamberi pemhuri yavo. “Vana vangu vachanamata Mwari wangu kusvika ndafa.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It’s a right of a father. Hakuna mwana wangu achabuda paChechi pano. Hapana patinosiya tisina kuvaka. Handina muzukuru anonamata elsewhere. Handina muzukuru anonamata CCAP. Handina muzukuru anonamata Watchtower. Handina muzukuru anonamata Roma. Ndine vanonamata Mwari wandinonamata iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende hapana anoita nharo neni panguva iyoyo, nekuti ndendichivaratidza manana aitwa naMwari iye…? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Unenge uchifamba navo uchivaratidza kuti, “Hona mwana–muzukuru. Uri kuona? Ndozvinoita Mwari watinonamata izvozvi izvi. Hauna kwaunozviwana izvi.” Ende ini ndiri kutaura chokwadi. Kumusha kwedu haku…? [Congregation says, “hakuna.”] Munharaunda dzatakakurira handina kuzvio…? [Congregation says, “kuzviona.”] Vatakaona vachiita mabhazi nemagonyeti vaichekeresa nekuuraya vanhu vachibheura mabhazi. Ropa rega rega. Hapana watakaona anozviita nekugona. Kana mumwe chete. Yaive mishonga. Lord, raise a righteous generation. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ine pfuma yakarurama che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona, Jakopo aakufa, akapa mwana wake mumwe nemumwe zvaifanira kuzoitika kwaari hupenyu hwake hwe…? [Congregation says, “hwese.”] Handei kuna Genesis, chapter 48. Tasvika? Genesis 48. Aah, 49, Genesis 49. [Blank spot on tape—ED]…—49 tichiona. Kana tasvika ngatiiti Amen tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] This is wonderful. Handei pa Genesis 49 tione. Hativerengeyi kubva pa verse 1, tese, verse 1 tese: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndinganzwa Amen here ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vangu ndinovaudza zvinosara zvichivawira ini ndisisi…? [Congregation says, “ndisisipo.”] Ndiani asingadi right iyoyo? Pastor Chuma vanounganidza vana avo ava.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Garai panaapa vana vangu. Ndoda kukutaurirai. Muri kuona zvaita uyu izvi? Haararami uyu. Uchafa uyu. Haana–haachembere uyu. Muri kuona uyuyu? Teedzerai tsika yaita uyu. Uyu hakuna chichamumisa muhupenyu. Achava munhu anobudirira stereki. Iwe, ndiri kukupa charge. Rega kukangamwa amai vako ava. Ndakupa responsibility yepamba panoapa. Iwe, rega kukangamwa ku farm uku. Ndakupa responsibility yeku farm. Zvamunenge mawana ikoko munouya nazvo zvese pa…? [Congregation says, ‘pano/Amen.’] Vana vangu muchasara muchiita vanhu vakuru, nekuti Mwari wandinonamata ndataura navo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Alright. Kuti muone kuti that is very true, muchaziva here kuti Brother Branham, vakanamatira vana vavo zvavaida kuti vadii…? [Congregation says, “vaite.”] Havana kutaura kuti, “Joseph, you shall be a prophet?” Vakataura here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Waive huporofita hwekuporofita iyeye? Waive hwekupa ma Spoken Wor…? [Congregation says, “Words.”] Kunyangwe akafara sei munyika, nguva yekuti mupfanha uya achidzokera, achitanga kugadzira ma Spoken Word achia distributer nyika yose yakwana, akadzokera. Ndiye akatanga kuita tuma Spoken Word taive ne wheat kumasure. A furu [full—ED] time mubasa raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari,”] sezvakadhizaya [desire—ED] baba vaani…? [Congregation says, “vake.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hanzi baba vake vakamunamatira zvikanzi, “Josefa, muregerei,” vachiudza vana Peary Green. “Ndamuisa pamberi paMwari. Achadzoka chete.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndinganzwa Hallelujah here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Hallelujah/Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvikanzi, “Billy Paul, I have called you, I have prayed for you, that God might show you the Angel that I work with. The reason is, God has given you, me, to work with me.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mungaita Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mungaita Amen akadarika ipapo here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Billy Paul haana kuzombofa akapinda pakusevenza pa company kana muhofisi youmwe munhu. Akangoshendera–shandira zvebasa raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Mupfanha wake achidzoka, Joseph Branham, ndiye akatenderera naye kuuya naye muno mu Africa achimu introducer, kuti, “My father said Joseph Branham will be a prophet. Inini ndakaa ndakafana ndakachengeta nokuti ndaishanda nababa vangu. But now that Joseph has come, ndiye aakutanga kugadzira ma Spoken Word manyo…?” [Congregation says, “panyowani.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tikagara navo muhotera zvikanzi, “I’m introducing my young brother. Mwari akaita nyasha sezvakataura muporofita, William Marrion Branham. Akati mupfanha uyu anodzoka, ende mupfanha uyu adzo…? [Congregation says, ‘adzoka.’] Iye zvino ndiye aakuita take charge yekugadzirwa kwema Spoken Wor…? [Congregation says, ‘Words.’] Inini, I sit back. I hand over nekuti baba vangu vakazvitaura vachiri vape…?” [Congregation says, “vapenyu.”] Taivemo tese takagara mu Sheraton kudai zvichitaurwa izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Brother Branham vakasunga vana vavo. Vasunga vana vavo, even vasikana. One aka rebel-a, nanhasi ari kurarama mu poverty. One akateerera, agere zvakanaka nemurume wake nanhasi so. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Rebecca Smith, akaroorwa na George. Vatova mushumiro iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”] But the young man was a Baptist. Baba vake vakati, “Enda unotora mukomana wako uuye naye ndimuwone.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Auya zvikanzi, “He is a good young man.” Zvikanzi, “This young man will really support the Message. He’s i–he’s honest at heart. Get married to him.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuona zvakaita baba vacho ka hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vavo vakasiya vavataurira zvavanoda ende zvakaitika sai…? [Congregation says, “saizvozvo.”] Tingaita Amen here hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende Brother Branham was a prophet and a man of integrity because aenda Brother Branham, vana vavo vese vakasara vachiropafa…? [Congregation says, “ropafadzwa.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vakasara vari mubasa raMwa…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Joseph arimo. Billy Paul arimo.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Iye zvino ukaenda ku Amereka, ku library yakavakwa, yard yakavakwa yavakatenga vakavaka pekugadzira ma tape nema book, akanga ari in charge kwaigadzirwa ma tape nema book, mwana mukomana, first born ya Billy Paul. Muri kuona kuti dzinza rese raakutobatana naipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Raakungoenda rakangonangana naipapo dzinza ro…? [Congregation says, “rose.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe…” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Every father has a right in the Message of the ho…? [Congregation says, “the hour.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Billy Pouro angasiye kwavo-kwaanzi nababa tinoshanda tese akaona ngirozi, mutumwa akamuona? Heh? Akamuona mutumwa. Joseph Branham akarohwa nechiporofita akaisirwa muteuro angaende nekupi? Rebecca Smith na George Smith vakanamatirwa nomuporofita, vangaende nekupi? Munhu waMwari akasunga ma futures avo ose kuti kwacha. The right of a father. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ita hushamwari naMwari nhasi iwewe brother pano, ugotongera vana vako zvaunoda kuti vasare vachidii…? [Congregation says, “vachiita.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei muone ipapo. [blank spot—ED] Verse 2 tese. Hativerengei pa verse 2 tese tione. Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: ‘‘Unganai! Unganai, unganai, unganai, unganai. Munzwe kubva kuna baba venyu.’’ [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muri kuona kuti zita raaishandisa apo, ati tererai Jakobho? Tarirai zvaataura apo. Tarirai muone zvaataura pa…?... Verse [blank spot—ED] Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Who gave him the name Israel? [Congregation says, “God.”] He was given a—by an angel at Peniel. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoraakabva ataura zvikanzi, “Tererai Isiraeri.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mukuona kuti akanga afamba hupenyu hwake hwese achitungamirirwa nengirozi iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”] Mwari iyeye ndiye aimupa chekudya hupenyu hwake hwe…? [Congregation says, “hwese.”] Zvikanzi, “Chindiunganirai pano ndichikuudzai, zvinokuteverai inini ndabva pano.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Akuvapa manje mwana mumwe nemumwe mugove waani…? [Congregation says, “wake.”] Handei tinoverenga verse 3 tese. Handei muna ver… [blank spot—ED] Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuona zvaataura? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Reuben uchaita chimiro. Remekedzo ichange iri pauri uri dangwe. Simba unenge unaro. Une dignity, the way you carry yourself. I’ve given you that. But…”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handei munoona. Handei pa verse 4 tese, hativerengei tese. Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch. “Hudangwe ndatotora.” Akaudzwa masikati mache…? [Congregation says, “machena.”] Kuti, “Hauchisiri da…? [Congregation says, “dangwe.”] Haufe wakaita mukuru kuvana ava!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Imagine confidence yanga ine murume uyu. How do you know kuti mwana uyu achasara oita tuma tricks twake? A’akufa, akufa Jakobho, kwaakutaura kuti, “Iwewe, hausare uchitungamirira vanhu. Wakapinda pamachira iwewe a—a—a—amainini vako. Wakatora mainini iwe. You will not excel! Whether you like it or…?” [Congregation says, “or not.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Every day muhupenyu hwangu, ndinonyengetera kuti, “Mwari ndipeiwo simba iri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndipeiwo simba pamusoro pedzinza raani…?” [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “rangu.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndoda kuti, “Vana vangu unganai. Ndasvika pazera rino iri, nekuchengetwa naMwari iyeyu weShongwe yeGore reMoto. Mwari weMwenga, Mwari webarika ndiye andichengeta. Ndosaka makawanda kudai. Vanangu chimirai, ndichikutaurirai masariro, amosara makaita pano. Iwewe ndiwe dangwe rangu asi wakakanya!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Uri kuudza mwana wako mukomana izvozvo. “Respect unayo, dignity unayo, vanokuziva kuti uri mukoma wavo vapfanha ava. But hauchafe waka-excela.” [to excel—ED] Ende muri kuona zvaari [1:24:12-inaudible] That Jacob was now telling him, zvaakanga amutongera, asina kuzviburitsa pache…? [Congregation says, “pachena. Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Akaziva kuti,

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Handingamuudze izvi ndichiri kusa—tarisana nani…? [Congregation says, “naye.”] Now that nda’akufa chirega ndimudii…?” [Congregation says, “ndimuudze.”] But musi wapinda Reuben pamubhedha pababa, mutongo uyo, ndopawakadii…? [Congregation says, “pawakauya.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Now, ndoda kuti munhu wese ati Amen ipapa hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiite Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti muone kuti mutongo uyu ndopawakapuhwa, pavakatora Josefa, va’akuda kuuraya, iye aka-suggesta [he suggested—ED] kuti, “Handei tinomukanda muyi… mugomba.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Muchazviziva? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndobva vanomukanda mu pit, yakanga isina chii… mvura. Then gare gare, Judah ndokubva auya nehweseri, Reuben asingadii…? [Congregation says, “asingazivi.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tingade taiverenga nyaya yacho kuna …?... but nenguva yeduzve. Handi’muri kuona kuti, aenda nehweseri ndobva ati kuvanhu, “Honai ma Shunamite ari kubva apa, handei rinoburitsa ani…Josefa. Tirege kumuuraya tiwane profit.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndobva vanotora Josefa, ndokumutengesa. Reuben ndokumhanya, ndokunosvika asi…? [Congregation says, “asiko.”] Ndokubva abvunza vamwe vake vese kuti, “Ko mupfanha mamuisa kupi?”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hapana akamudii…? Dangwe huya hwakanga hwatorasika ka…? [Congregation says, “kare.”] Sechishuwo chababa vasati vachitau…? [Congregation says, “vachitaura.”] Iye zvino vaakufa vata—ta’akunzwisisa why vafanha vake vakamuita mabatiro avakamudii…? [Congregation says, “avakamuita.”] Baba vakanga vaisa mutongo wavo ka…? [Congregation says, “kare. Amen.”] Hatisi kunzwa Amenika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hakuna chinhu chinonakidza brother seShoko raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi the wisest person would just come from learning the Bible not philosophy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The wisest person will come from understanding the Bible, a revelation of the Bible not anything else. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Jakobho akanga atongera— [1:26:19-inaudible]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Ah, mupfanha ndinofamba ini, wosara uchipinda kunotora konku [concubine—ED] rangu? Concubine rangu ini? Heh? Mupfanha, waita pasi pamera chii…? [Congregation says, “ziso.”] You will not head this tribe again! Noone will give you respect again! You are stupid!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura makes heaving sounds as he dramatizes Jacob—ED] Dhara ndobva yagara pasi, yanga yaita heart attack. Mozoita heart attack kuti mwana wangu atora mukadzi. Heh? Akaenda akanogara pasi kuti [Apostle Gumbura illustrates making sounds—ED] but dza’akufa manje dziri pamubhedha, vese vakagara kudai. Zvikanzi, “Iwewe chikonzero vafanha vakakurova two-note paya, inyaya yako yakakukwidza pamachira angu. You will not excel nevapfanha ava. You won’t,” says Jacob. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Nekuti Jacob akanga aine chikwambo chemumusha. Chikwambo chemumusha, akanga ari Jehovha! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Wa’atsamwira, atsamwira zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”] Wa’aropafadza, aropafadzwa zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”] That’s The right of a father! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen vanhu vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Ameni iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handei munoona next futi. Hativerengei verse 5 tese. Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations. O… Handei tese. O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall. Verse 7. Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel. Manzwa zvaataura?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Hamuchafa makaita boka rinozviumba riri ro…? [Congregation says, “riri roga.”] Ndichakudhivhaidhayi, ndokuskatayi! [I will scatter you—ED] You will not be a family yakanzi ya—ya Simeon, hazvisi kuitika.” Ndovaya vakatsamwisa baba. Baba vati, “Ngatiitei sungano neve Shechem.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Pana mambo we Shechem akanga atora Dinah, handi’muchazviziva? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mambo we Shechem atora Dinah, vafanha ava ndobva varonga kuti vanhu vaya vakadzingiswa vachirwadziwa, ndokupinda mumusha ndokuuraya vo…? [Congregation says, “vose.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “Mandiita kuti ndinhuhwe kuma neighbours aani…?” [Congregation says, “angu.”] Musi iwoyo ndowavakatongerwa nyaya yavari kuudzwa iyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen ka hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuona, ndomusi wavakatongerwa nyaya iyi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndomusi wavapihwa judgment manheru iwa…? [Congregation says, “iwayo.”] Baba vacho vakabva vati, “Ngatichibvai pano patiri kugara pano. Ngatitizeyi tiende ku…? [Congregation says, “kure,”] kure! Hmm? Hatitizeyi tiende kure. Handei kure, kuresa, kuresa, kuresa! Tanhuwa kuma neighbours edu. Tanyadzisa kuma neighbours edu. Tichashorwa kuma neighbours edu. Hatitizeyi tiende kure!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuona zvakaitika manheru aya? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende vafanha ava, havana chavakazomboita. Levi munombomunzwa achitaurwa? Right, kuti muone, is Levi counted as a tribe among the twelve tribes? [Congregation says, “no.”] Moziva zvakabva ku—akaskatiwa [he was scattered—ED] mune vamweka? Akatobvisiwa. Akanodzingiwa, sekutaura kwaJako…? [Congregation says, “kwaJakobho.”] Future yese.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Brother kana uri babaka, ari kubereka vana vako, uri panzvimbo tsvene yakaiswa Zita raMwari, unorongera vana vako ramangwana ravo vese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Hakuna mwanangu anoita mu rasta ndaramba! Hakuna mwana wangu anobudirwa nedhimoni rekuKenzamba ndaramba! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiri kuda dzinza nyowani mukati memhuri yekuKenzamba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzinza remutendi!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handei mberi tione.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handei pa verse 8 muone Judah. Mukuona pana Judah apa, hatiendei pana Judah tione. Judah, thou art … Verse 8 tese. Hativerengei tese. Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee. Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Haah! Judah, ndiwe uchakudzwa nevamwe vako ve…? [Congregation says, “vese.”] Judah ndiwe uchatyisa iwewe. Hauzi munhu achadherereka. Judah, remekedzo yevanin’ina vako vose ichauya kwau…?” [Congregation says, “kwauri.”] Muri kuona kuti atora nzvimbo ya Reube…? [Congregation says, “ya Reuben.”] Apuhwa nani…? [Congregation says, “nababa.”] The right of a father. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Munoziva kuti moverenga Bhaibheri haumbozvioni kuti zvirimo zvinhu izvi. Humbozvifungidziri kuti zviri…? [Congregation says, “zvirimo.”] Hativerengei muone, pazasi pacho, this is won… [blank spot—ED] Toda pa verse ya 10. Iyo ndoyandinoda chaizvo. Hativerengei verse 10, tione. The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a Lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hatinyararei. Chinondinakidza, preciseness yenyaya ya…? [Congregation says, “yacho.”] Moona Bhaibheri harivanzi? Hanzi, “Iwewe, you will have a sceptre, chinotonga. And pachaita Lawgiver anobva kwauri.” Ende abva ataurwa kwaanobva. Hanzi, “Anobva pakati pemakumbo ako.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ha’moona ataurirwa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Anobva pakati pemai…? [Congregation says, “pemakumbo ako.”] Ende ndomwana akauya na Tamar. Handi’moona mwana akauya na Tamar? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndokwakaberekwa Phare…? [Congregation says, “Pharez,”] Pharez. Kwaberekwa Pharez, Pharez ndo genealogy yaIshe Je…? [Congregation says, “yaJeso.”] “Lawgiver ichabva pakati pemakumbo ako.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ha’moona Bhaibhiri riri kutaura. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] Handisati ndakamboona chinhu chiri precise seShoko raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “A Lawgiver, a scepter, pakati pemakumbo ako, ndopachabuda Lawgiver iwewe. Kureva kuti uchabuda, mumhuri yaani…? Haazi kubva kuno family yako kana mukadzi wako, uchabuda. Wabuda waenda kuna Tamar uko, ikokoko kauko, ndokuchamisa nekuda kwe—pakati pemakumbo ako. Ndokuchanobuda Lawgiver yacho iko…?” [Congregation says, “ikoko, Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tinganzwa Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa taurai Amen yemazviro kwazvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Riri kutaura pachena-chena Bhaibhiri. Ndosaka mukaenda kuna Tamar, Tamar akati aane nhumbu zvikanzi, “Two people are struggling in my side [1:33:24-inaudible]”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Anga ari ma twi…? [Congregation says, “ma twins.”] Ndobva pabuda Pharez. Pharez iye uya uya, ndopanobuda Jeso Kris…? [Congregation says, “Jeso Kristu.”] A Lawgiver from in between the legs of Judah. Ende akataura ndiani? [Congregation says, “ndibaba; Jacob.”] Jacob.The right of a father. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ini handisati ndakamboona chinhu chinondinakidza seShoko raMwari. Ndinonakidzwa nezvakawanda but Shoko raMwari rinopfuura zvo…? [Congregation says, “zvose.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunyanya kana richidudzirika kudai, Mwari achikupai nya…? [Congregation says, “nyasha.”] Haaah! Baba vese vari pano, mupfanha uchikudza vana vako kudai, uchivaona vachikura kudai. Ziva kuti iwewe kana ukanamata zvakanaka uri panzvimbo tsvene, zvinowira vana ava, even wabva pano, unosiya wazvironga ndi…? [Congregation says, ndiwe.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka ma brother achasiya vana vavo vachitambira, tinongokutorerai maGwaro aya, atakaverenga, “…vana vemapenzi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vebenzi vanokurira mu street kid, but baba vane chizaruro, chenzvimbo tsvene, unopinga zvose zvaunoda, panzvimbo tsvene iyoyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Every time pande’ndichiona vana vangu twenty-four, vachitamba kudai, vachimhanya, vachitamba, vachitamba, vachitamba, vachitamba. Inini nde’ndakanyarara zvangu kudai, ndichiziva kuti vana avaka, ndotofanira kuvarongera ramangwana rakana…? [Congregation says, “rakanaka.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndikatadza kunamata zvakanaka, [1:34:51-inaudible] ramangwana rakanaka rino rasika ro…? [Congregation says, “rose.”] But ndikavarongera zvakanaka, vese vachabuda kuti sharp shoot, sharp shoot. The man of integrity vana vake vanosara vachiropafadzwa iye adii…? [Congregation says, “aenda. Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka munhu waMwari, iwe ndokukumbira chinhu chimwe chete. Kana wakawana ava pashumiro inoyi; chidzidza, zvinodzidziswa pashumiro iyoyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ugosiya warongera vana vako nhaka yakadii…? [Congregation says, “yakanaka.”] Tingaita Amen here hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vana Pastor Chuma ava, vane madzimai maviri ava. Vanenge vane vana kuma twelve, fifteen uko. Hah? Vari mubarikaka. Vane Brother Nehohwa, vanenge vane vana kuma ten, eleven. Vana Brother Gwendere vane madzimai matatu, vana vanenge va’akuma ten, eleven. Vana vanofanira kusiya vaudzwa manje kuti, “Mwanangu, kuti ubudirire muhupenyu, ndini baba vako.” Ndozvinose’enzeswa nababa vedu vasinganamate kuti, “Kudza baba namai.” Wonzi, “Hande kun’anga.” “Kudzai baba namai.” “Zvonzi, “Hande tinorova makuva.” “Kudza baba namai.” “Zvonzi, “Buda muChechi.” “Kudza baba namai.” “Zvonzi, “Svora chokunamata.” “Kudzai baba namai…”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka vana vakomana vazhinji, vechitangwe, vanofa vana baba vavo vari vape…? Makambozviona munyika umo? Vazhiniji. Anofirwa nematangwe ake ese, nevana vake vakomana vese, vagopera kudai. Iye ari mupenyu akangovada—aitanga dangwe rake, agotevera anotevera, mugotevera anotevera, mugotevera anotevera.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vakomana vese vanopera kuti mbo, iye ari mupenyu. Ukanozvitarisa it’s a curse that was in Egypt. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] When the curse came in Egypt, yaitora ma first what…? [Congregation says, “borns.”] Yaitora ma first borns. Mukuona zvinenge zvaitika apa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Kuti muone kuti inyaya ine curse yaive pana Judha uyu, nenyaya yake yekubata Josefa? Akatorerwa Onan, akanga ari first born yaani? [Congregation says, “yake.”] Mwari havanzvengwe! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa Amen handisi kumunzwaka ini hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Wakaona va—vakabva vafa, ha’moona? Ndikaenda kumusha kwedu kuKenzamba uko, ndozviriko manje uko. Baba vangu vakarasikirwa nedangwe ravo. Handi’moona? First-born yemumba mavo babamukuru, dangwe ravo rakashaya. Panzvimbo yekuti ringe riripo iye zvino richitungamirira mhuri yo…? [Congregation says, “yose.”] Matangwe ndoanopera, even kunyangwe vari vasikana.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Toenda kwa,aDhagwi, dangwe rakashaya. Toenda kwa’a aDaniel, dangwe rakashaya. Moona zvinenge zvichiitika muhupenyu? Kune dangwe benyu, ndekwa’a Soromoni. But dangwe iri rakatiza mu ZAO…? [Congregation says, “mu ZAOGA.”] Rikaroorwa naJaricha. Ha’moona zvinoitika mukati mehupenyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanopera vese matangwe, mugoshaya kuti vanhu, va—ma brothers six anofirwa nematangwe che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Vamwe vatiri kutaura misha yakavhara, vana vese vakomana hakuchisi…? [Congregation says, “hakuchisina.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ivo vatiri kutaura dangwe rechisikana rakatiza ku ZAOGA, hanzvadzi dzaro mbiri, dzakapera dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose,”] dzose, musha ukavhara. Waona musha wavhara apa, musha wavhara apa, musha wavhara apa, musha wavhara apa, musha wavhara apa. But Mwari kana vainewe, dangwe rako rinotevera mutsoka dzako chaimo, chaimo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndo right yaunenge uina…? [Congregation says, “uinayo.”] Hama iyi, haisi nyaya yekutamba nayo kune vanoda kuziva Message. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba vakatora chikwambo mumusha, ndakakuudzayi, chinotonga musha we…? [Congregation says, “wese.”] Atsamwirwa nechikwambo ichocho hazvimuitire zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakanaka.”] Ukateketererwa zvakanaka, chikwambo chechichifara iwe unosimuka. Chinokurwisa chikwambo ichocho kusvika waita zvinoda baba ivavo. Zvino isu hatina kuunza zvikwambo mumisha, takaunza Jeso! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vana vako vese brother, unovapinga naJesu iye…? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”] Angonwa doro chete, hakuna munhu. Angoputa fodya chete, hakuna munhu. Musikana angoita musikanzwa ahura ku Avenues, hakuna munhu. Ende, zvisati zvatanga kuitika, zva’zvakadii kuti ubva wangotanga wabata zivo yacho kana zvoitika urege kutinetsa nemubvu…? [Congregation says, “nemubvunzo.”] “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavadii…? [Congregation says, ‘ngavanzwe,’] zvinotaura chii…? [Congregation says, ‘Mweya,] Mweya kupiko?” [Congregation says, “kuKereke.”] Satan come out, right away! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Kune vanoda Mwari, Mwari unovasunungura haikona zvekutamba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka mukaona chizvarwa chino chatiri kurarama chino ichi, handi’maona, ukangoerekana wapinda pakunamata, haudi zango, haudi dumwa. Chitora Bhaibhiri rive dumwa rako. Chitora Bhaibhiri rive tokoroshi yako. Chitora Bhaibhiri rive zango rako. Zvaunotaura nemuromo wako kudai, zvinoitika.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Imimi vamwe vangu vari muno maakuziva kuti Pastor zvavakabvira kutaura kubvira shumiro yavo ichitanga, zvizhinji zvavakataura zvakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvakaitika. Amen”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya wandinawo ndounenge wapinda mauri, Shoko randinaro ndorinenge rapindawo mau…? [Congregation says, “mandiri.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Chaunenge wataura chinodii…? [Congregation says, “chinoitika.”] Ukati kumwana wako, “Haufe wakaita chinhu ukapota uchindiitira nharo dzauri kuita idzi,” zvechokwadi haadi…? [Congregation says, “haaite.”] Ukati, “Uyu ndiye mwana uyu, muchamuona kusimuka kwaachaita.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndiye anodii iyeye…? [Congregation says, “anosimuka.”] The right of a father. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka iwewe nhasi, iti, “Mwari ndoda kunamata ndikudze vana vangu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Kana wanga uchida kudzokera kumashure, chinamatira chii… vana. Munoziva here kuti Solomon akanga asingafanire kupedza hushe hwake achitonga? Nekuti akanga aroora vakadzi vakanzi Mwari, usaroo…? [Congregation says, “usaroora.”] Asi Mwari vakanga vavimbisa Mambo Dhavhidhi kuti, “Mwana wako anenge aenda pachigaro, handimubvisepo. Kana akaita misikanzwa ndinomurova neshamhu dzevana vevanhu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”] Ende zvakaitika saizvozvo here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The young man was so outlandish no one can do that and escape the punishment of God. But mupfanha uya akaenda kunoroora vakadzi vaakanzi naMwari asaroore. Aenda kunoroora vakadzi vaakanzi naMwari asaroore, he went on kuno vavakira matembere muJerusa…? [Congregation says, “Jerusarema.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ah! But God was bound by a pro…? [Congregation says, “promise.”] Yakanga yatsvakiwa naba…? [Congregation says, “nababa. Amen.”] The right of a father! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vana vedu vakawanda vachaita misikanzwa imwe isingamboiti. But iwe baba unogona kuchinja misikanzwa iye kuti, Mwari vaite mwoyo murefu, iwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiwe unogona kuita kuti, “Mwari vana vangu vanonetsa ava. Va—hamenowo maonero avo kana chavakabatika nacho kana chavakare-svora. Asi dai maita mwoyo murefu mambondipa nguva navo. Ndimboshanda navo Baba.’’

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Wotanga kuvanamatira kuti vajekerwe, vanojekerwa one by…? [Congregation says, “by one.”] But iwe ukati, “Reuben, how dare you?! You will not be the head of my children.” Watomuuraya Reuben. Watopedza nani…? [Congregation says, “naye.”] “Simeon and Levi, after I have an agreement with people as a gentleman, you go behind my back and you kill people?! Instruments of cruelty. You shall never remain as a body, scattered shall you be in the rest of your brethren.” [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Aya anonzi masimba! [Congregation says, “Amen!”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, The right of a …? [Congregation says, “father.”] Ndiani asingaide right yakadai vanhu vaMwari, iyoyo? Kureva kuti vana vako uchibereka kudai, unotovatongera ndiwe kuti, “Mwanangu zvawaita izvozvo izvo, ndakukata murudzi urwu.” Ukatotaura kuti, “You shall not be a part of this family; they will consider you an alien in this family.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Uchizvitaura izvozvo. Paunofa zvinosara zvichidi…? [Congregation says, “zvichingoitika.”] “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe…! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] …ngavanzwe zvinotaura chii…? [Congregation says, ‘Mweya,’] Mweya kupiko…?” [Congregation says, “kuKereke.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka akanzi, “Iwe Judah iwe, a Lawgiver shall not depart.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handei munoona paza… pamberi apo. Verse 10, handei pa verse 10 tese. Hativerengei 10 tese. The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a Lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come;… Handei mberi …and unto Him shall the gathering of the people be.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “…And unto him shall the gathering of the people be.” Vanhu havana kuungana here muna Jeso Kristu? [Congregation says, “vakaungana.”] Lawgiver yakauya here muna Jeso Kristu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Scepter yehutongi haina kubudaka muna Judah? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvakataurwa kudha…? [Congregation says, “kudhara.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handei pa verse ya 11 tese. Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes: And his eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Wine inomirira stimulation of re…? [Congregation says, “of revelation.”] Ropa i redempti…? [Congregation says, “redemption. Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Huchi nemukaka iropafa…? [Congregation says, “ropafadzo.”] Hanzi, “Your teeth shall be white with milk.” Ha-ha! [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] Muri kuona kuti Judah chakapuhwa zvoseka ichi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Anopa ndiani…? Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handei [blank spot—ED] verse 13 hativerengei tose. Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon. Verse 14. Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens: Handei mberi. And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuona zvakatoitika. Akatoita servant ku tribute. Handei pa ver-ver… Yandiri kuda i Dan. Ha—handei pa verse 16 tese. Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel. Handei mberi. Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward. Handei mberi. I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuona zvataurwa apa? Dan manje, hanzi, “You shall be a serpent,” handitika? “Munzira.” Munoziva kuti mu Dan ndomakaiswa mupunzo na Jeroboa…? [Congregation says, “Jeroboam.”] Did he become a serpent indeed? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanhu vairumwaka neikunamata mupunzoka uku? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Handisati ndakamboona inini, baba vanonamata mu Message, vanotaura chinhu chikasadi…? [Congregation says, “chikasaitika.”] Kunyanya vari panzvimbo tsve…?[Congregation says, “tsvene,”] yakaiswa Zita nani…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”] Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Dan became a really serpent as the father said. Vana ava mukazoverenga history yese yevana ivavo ma tribes iwaya, muchaona kuti zvakataurwa naJokobho a’akufa, ndozvakasara zvoitika kwavari ve…? [Congregation says, “vese.”] “Ndosaka ndati regai ndikuudzei zvichava zvoitika ini ndadii…?” [Congregation says, “ndaenda.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ende zvainodzokera kubvira zvinhu zvichikonzerwa nezvakatanga zvichiitika iye achiri mupe…? [Congregation says, “mupenyu.”] Misikanzwa imwe yavakabata, akavatsuura vakasaterera panguva yaani…? [Congregation says, “yavo.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ma brothers ane ma parents ari mu Message, batai chizaruro apa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana Brother Musasa ava, vanofana kubata chizaruro ichocho. 221Mudhara a’akushaya uyu, anofanira kuti ati, “Baba ndiisei ropafadzo.” Ava VaMusasa vakaisa ruoko rwavo pamusoro va—vakati, “Manu ndakusiira mhuri. Mwari mubatsirei kuti mhuri yandamusiira agone kuidii…? Kuichengeta, nepfuma. Pamusha wake ngapanunire mombe, mbudzi nehwayi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pamusha pake ngapadai. Zvamaamakarongera kundiitira, zvadumudzirwa nehupenyu, ndinozvikumbira zviuye paari.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”; Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Pamusha pake ngapadai. Zvamamakarongera kundiitira zvadurudzirwa nehupenyu, ndinozvikumbira zviuye paari!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hah! Hah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika Ameni! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chipfanha chinonunira ichi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanomuroya kumusha kwese havamukwani…? [Congregation says, “havamukwanisi.”] The Right of a Father. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ma brother ngaajekerwe nenyaya iyoyo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] musiye mavaka dzinza rakanaka! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka iwewe kana uchikudza vana vakoso, vari vakomanaso, tarisa stereki. Ende learn to be a fair brother. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Be indeed a fair fa…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “father; Amen.”] Kura uchitarisaso, uchionaso. Uchionaso. Ha’moona? Nokuti mwana waunonzwa kuda mumwoyo mako, handitika, kana une Mweya waMwari, hakusi kumuda kwemataridzikiro kana chimiro. Mweya yenyu yadii…? [Congregation says, “yawirirana,”] yawirirana. [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen!! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Haumusarudze nemazi…? [Congregation says, “nemaziso.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Rogona kunge riri dofo kuchikoro. Vanhu vanotozviona kuti, “Babaka, pane mupfanha uyu vanomu favour too…?” [Congregation says, “too much.”] Akaita misikanzwa, pamwe unongodismisser, [you dismiss it—ED] kuti, “Hah, no.” Baba vanenge vachingoti, “Heh heh. Tibvireyi apa.” Zvatopera. Voga vagoshaya kuti, “Chii?” Ha’moona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Why do you think like that? Ndopanouya Josefa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Right. Baba vake Josefa, vaimudii…? [Congregation says, “vaimuda,”] vaimuda. Hanga Mweya waive muna Josefa, wa El, Elah, Elohim, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndoMweya wakanga uri munani…? [Congregation says, “muna Jacob,”] muna Jacob. Saka Mweya iyi yaidii…? [Congregation says, “yaiwirirana.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapa hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aive neMweya waMwari maari, saka aiwirirana nababa vaani…? [Congregation says, “vake.”] Nokuti baba vake vanga vakazarawo neMweya waani…? [Congregation says, “waMwari; Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: The young man did not have the opportunity to be raised by his father. The brethren sold him. Aenda kwaakaenda, akaratidza kuti ndiJakobho pa nature. He was a chip of the old what? [Congregation says, “block.”] Akasvika achiedzwa nemupunzo, achiramba. Achiedzwa navakadzi vema shefu, achiramba. Akamira naMwari weIsirairi ari kwaakanga ari iko…? [Congregation says, “ikoko; Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Chaenda kwachakaenda, chikanozviviga ikokoko. Kuratidza kuti Mweya waive maari wakanga uri waba—wababa vake, wokutungamirira rudzi rwose. Zvakaitika zvoga baba vasi…? [Congregation says, “vasipo.”] Pavakazosvika ikoko zvikanzi, “I thought I was never going to see you. But now I inherit your chi…?” [Congregation says, “children.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Favour yababa ndiyo yakamuitisa izvozvo here izvo? Handi’vakanga vasinga mu-train-e, vanga vasipo ? But Mweya waiva muna Josefa uyo, ndoMweya waiva muna Jako… ? [Congregation says, “Jakobho.”] Ndosaka baba vaimuda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika Ameni hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure Ameni iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah!”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ukaona mwana anodiwa nababa, handitika? Vakafanana. Chidzokerai kuna Soromon, handi’muchaona kuti Dhavhidha akati Soromoni ita? Dhavhidha, mischief yake yakawanda chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Kunyanya ine chekuita nemadzima…? [Congregation says, “madzimai.”] Akatorera munhu mukadzi akaponda murume wacho. Handi’murikuzviona?

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hatichiendayi kuna Soromon. Soromoni wakazobuda ma borders e—eIsirairi, akanotora futi kuyi…? [Congregation says, “kunze.”] While baba vakagona kuzvidzora nekutya Mwari vakaperera pa five hundred, Solomoni hachina kuzozvigona. Chakapfurira chikasvika ku one thou…? [Congregation says, “one thousand.”] He was a chip of the old block. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya yaive mavari yaiwirira…? [Congregation says, “yaiwirirana.”] Murikuzviona here zvandiri kutaura hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hakuna chinonakidza sokuti… Ini ndinogara ndichitaurira kana eh, ma sister. Wonzwa kuti, “Aah, Bati akafanana nemi. Bati akafanana nemi.” Ndoti, “Aah. Ngaave akafanana neni pazvose. But ngaarege kutakura zvinhu zviri mumusoro mangu. ” [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Handi’maona? Because unenge uchiziva mashandiro anoita pfungwa dzaani? [Congregation says, “dzako.”] Mashandiro epfungwa dzako, unenge uchifunga kuti, “Kukaita mwana anoita pfungwa dzinenge dzandiinadzo inini, I will pray for that boy.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Masha… Saka I would rather have a boy have exactly, exactly similar things like me, but zvekuzotora zviri mudehe—mudehenya iri. Mind yangu is just born rebellious. Ndakadzorwa nekunamata che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Stubborn! Anything that you can think. Ingori stubborn. Ndikat…Ndikatarisa munhu kana achiita misikanzwa. Ndikakuudza zvandiri kufunga ini ndakakutarisa. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka ndozoti, “No. I think mwana ngaafanane neni, hazviperere pa physical structure.” But manje hazvizoiti naipapo. Panouya chimwe chakangofanana nani…? [Congregation says, “newe.”] Exactly iwewe; mafungiro, behaviour, mafambiro, maitiro, zvose! Zvokuti wanguri wafa, vanhu vanogara vachitotaura kuti, “Izvozvo zvaita mwana uyu ka uyu, muna 1976, baba vacho… [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh—ED] Ha’maona…?... Baba vacho muna 1976, ndinovaziva baba vake. Zvaita mupfanha iyeyuyu. Muna ni… Baba vake…”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Unenge uchiona baba vake vachidzoka futi vari vapenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka mwana iyeye akavapo, iye mwana wacho haazvinzwisisi. Anenge achida baba vake ste…? [Congregation says, “stereki.”] Ivo babawo futi havazvidii…? [Congregation says, “havazvinzwisisi.”] Vanenge vachida mwana wavo futi ste…? [Congregation says, “stereki.”] Ngatitangeyi kunamatira mhuri dzedu! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatitangeyi kunamatira mhuri dzedu wi—izvozvi! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Baba ndiri baba. Mwari, ndiri baba. Nda’ane vana vasikana two. Nda’ane vana vasikana three. Nda’ane vana vasikana vatatu, nemukomana mumwe chete. Nda’ane vakomana vaviri vasikana vaviri. Saka ndiri kutya kuri kuenda hupenyu hwangu. Ndanga ndichikumbira kuti mundipe njere, kumira neShoko, kunyatsotendeka. Ndisiye ndaraira mhuri nemazvo!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Ameni varanda vaMwari ? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo!
