[Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hatipedzeyi naJosefa muone zvandiri kutaura. Verse 22. Hatipedzeyi naJosefa. Handeyi pa verse 22. Tese. Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall: Hatione verse 23. The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Manzwa matauriro aiita chirume ichi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Vanomuvenga vakamuuraya chaizvo, nomuse…? [Congregation says, “nemuseve.”] But Mwari akamusimbi…? [Congregation says, “vakamusimbisa.”] Mwari waani…?” [Congregation says, “waIsaka naJakobho.”] Aah! Verengayi muone. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi tione ver… Hationeyi muone pa verse eh 22 tese. Verse 22 tese. Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mudhara aida mupfanha uyu zvisina mubvunzo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiti Ameni varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka akakwanisa kusvika paakadii…? [Congregation says, “paakasvika.”] I believe; Jacob, was Joseph. Joseph; was Jacob. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Moona zvandiri kutaura handiti? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti mukaona, ataura kutika, Josefa ndiye shepherd weIsirairi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Jo—Jo—Jo—Josefa; ndiro dombo, nheyo, foundation. “Upon this rock I will build my …?” [Congregation says, “Church.”] Murikuona zvarataura apa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Rataura zvese izvozvo ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Kuti, “Josefa ndiwe zvese iwewe.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Nekuti izvozvozvo Jakobho ndozvaakanga a…? [Congregation says, “ari; Amen.”] Jacob was a pastor. Jacob was a shepherd. And Jacob Vhangeri yake, haina kunoita umbrera [umbrella—ED] pama brethren ake chete. Yakanoenda nekuma Gentiles kwe…? [Congregation says, “kwese.”] Avawo, Josefa uyu, Vhangeri yake yakati yabatsira the eleven, yakazoenda mberi kunobatsira maIgipita o…? [Congregation says, “ose.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen; Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen; Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Murikuona Shoko raMwari kunaka kwarakaita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka Jacob and Joseph were identical. Mweya waive muna Josefa ndoMweya waive muna Jako…? [Congregation says, “Jacob.”] And there was no way that boy could not prosper, kunyangwe kari ka last bor…? [Congregation says, “last born.”] Baba vataura. Hati…Hatidzokorore. Kusvika pa verse 24. Tese hativerengeyi: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiye mufudzi wavo ve…? [Congregation says, “vese.”] Padombo iroro ndichavaka Kere…? [Congregation says, “Kereke; Amen.”] Mungaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiye Jakobho uyu. Jakobho ndiye akavaka the twelve tribes of I…? [Congregation says, “Israel.”] Iye a’akuchibvisa kuvaka kwaakaita, twelve tribes of Israel, akudziisa panani? Pana Josefa. Iye ndiye aivafudza achifamba navo achiti, “Ngatibveyi pano paipa. Ngatibveyi pano paipa. Ngatibveyi pano paipa.” Mushure maizvozvo, a’akuti, “Josefa iri rava basa raani…?” [Congregation says, “rako; Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen; Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen; Hallelujah.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Right. Kuti mubate zvandiri kutaura. Jakobho, handitika? Aivengwa here nemukoma Esau? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Murikuzviona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The only difference pana Josefa ndeyekuti, ma brothers acho anga awa…? [Congregation says, “awanda.”] But ivowo futi vaimudiiwo…? [Congregation says, “vaimuvenga.”] Sekuvengwa kwaiitwa… baba vake Jakobho, nemukoma, akatotsvaga kuda kuuraya. Ndomavengerwowo aiitwa Josefa, nevakoma vaani…? [Congregation says, “vake.”] Ndosaka Jakobho aimunzwisisa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen; Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen; Hallelujah.”] Ndosaka akaenda kuvana vaani? Ndobva aenda kuvana vaJosefa. Muri kuona akati, “Iwewe, ndiwe inini.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndobva ano correct-a zvaakaita iye achiba. Now, mukaenda kuna Jakobho. Jakobho akaba Birthright. Akaibira muko…? [Congregation says, “mukoma.”] Ha’moziva ndozvaakaita? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Akaenda akapfeka zvaakapfeka. Ndokugadzira chikafu chinodiwa nababa, chichirongewa namai. Baba vaya vakanga vasisaone, Isaac. Isaac ndokubata bata ndobva afunga, zvikanzi, “My son Esau.” Ndobva vapa ropafadzo rose. Pakazouya Esau manheru, zvikanzi, “Baba hakuna chasara?” Zvikanzi, “Too late. Ndapa zvose kuna Jakobho.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Iye wakaitora nekiribidi kiribidi. Amuvana vaJosefa, zvikanzi, “Handichada kuti uyu aite chikiribidi chandakaita inini. I will just do it inini.” [Apostle Gumbura crosses one hand over the other as Jacob did—ED; Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika Amenika! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Ameni iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen; Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen; Hallelujah.”] Muri kuona kuti experience iri kuitika muhupenyu hwaJosefa, ndo exactly yakaitika muhupenyu hwaJako…? [Congregation says, “hwa Jacob.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka ndiri kukutaurirai kuti, when you are a father uchiunza vanhu panyika, you—you have to shape a life for them. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba, ndovano shaper life inosara yotevera va…? [Congregation says, “vana.”] Handisi kunzwa Ameni ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vakashaya baba anovarongera life yeramangwana, vanoparara. Havavake chinhu chinomira. Ndiri kunzwawo Ameni here ipapa hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hamuna kunzwa zvandataura.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Murikuona sei vana vevahedheni, vachitanga kuzoita find themselves va’amuChe… muChechi. Nekuti kumba yababa kumusha, vanorova makuva nokupira mudzimu. Hakuna chaunogona kukopa kana kutevedzera ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Mukuona zvine’zvichiitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti utevedzere zvinoita baba vako, wakutongotsvaga divisi. Wakutongotsvaga tokoroshi. Wakutonotsvaga kuromba. Wakutonotsvaga dumwa. Saka hapana chaunodzidza.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka vana vevanhu vatema vanenge vachitarisa vabereki vavo vari munyika, baba vanenge vapererwa. Naivowo vodiiwo futi? [Congregation says, “vopererwa.”] But ndiri kuti mukunamata kwatiri makuri, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] “He who believeth in the Lord shall never be ashamed.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unenge uri panhano yokusiya uchinongedzera vana vaani…? [Congregation says, “vangu.”] Murikuona mutsauko watinawo vanhu vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Murikuona mutsauko wacho vanhu vaShe? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Inini kuna baba vangu ndaidzidzeyi? Ndaienda kumapako ekuZvumba. Tairidza mbira. Ndaienda kunotsvaga kun’anga kunoromba. Hapana chandaidzidza. Saka I found myself in grace. Ndazviita find my gra… myself in grace; I don’t want Tito, Munesu, Bati, or Gari, Victor kuti—kutsvanzvadzira vachitsvaga kuti hupenyu hunoendwa na—nepapi? Ndiani anoita pattern yehupenyu hwacho? [Congregation says, “ndimi; Amen.”] “Huya pano mupfanha. Huya pano, huya pano, huya pano. Hupenyu hunonzwayio. Aah, izvozvo regera, izvo. Eh, ndati regera izvo. Itaso. Hatiite so.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Kureva kuti iye asati amboziva chinonzi kunamata, anenge achimunamatira ndiani? [Congregation says, “ndiBaba,”] ndibaba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Soromoni hushe akahuwana nokuda kwaani…? [Congregation says, “kwababa.”] Ainamata zvakafadza Mwari kusvika ati, “Ndichatora mwana wako ndimuite mambo.” Ndiani? [Congregation says, “ndibaba.”] Vana vaJakobho avo kuti vateverwe naMwari kwese kwavari kuenda, akafadza Mwari ndiani apa? [Congregation says, “Jacob/ndibaba.”] Aah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Iwe ukafadza Mwari, iwewe! Ucharongera vana vako gwara! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndozvinonzi manje munhu waMwari haafaniri kuva munhu akadyiswa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Havafaniri kutongwa nevakadzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukatongwa nevakadzi vauchaita, uchaudza vana zvinobva kuna Mwari? Uchaudza vana zvinobva kumukadzi.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka imba yose ina baba vakadyiswa, vana vacho marombe! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti vabvisa order yaMwa…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”] Tingaita Ameni here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Imi madzimai akadyisa vana venyu, muri kuita kuti mwana wako mukomana ashaye dire…? [Congregation says, “direction.”] Nokuti direction uchamanikidzwa kuipa iwewe. Ende handizvo zvakarongwa naMwa…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”] Zvichakudzokera cheeete! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvichakudzokera wava chembere. Uchazvishora zvawakazvipinza mazvi…? [Congregation says, “mazviri.”] Wako mwana mukomana anobva angotangawo nokudyiswa nomuroora. Baba vemwana uyu wawaiwomesera, uchatsvukira muroora achikukwatura nembama wa’a mbuya. [Congregation laughs—ED] Unokwaturwa nembama mwana wako ari…? [Congregation says, “aripo.”] Kunzi,

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Imi amai nyararai imimi. Heh. Maiita izvozvo kumwana wenyu, hamuna kundizvaraka ini. Muri kundiita boyi renyu panapa, ndichikubikirai mese muri vaviri panapa? Ndinyararireyi ikoko!” “Mwanangu o…” Pwaa-aa! Murume woti, kuti, “Iii…” “Shut up!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Rokanyaira haro richienda kudaiwo gadzi o, ku kitchen. Munoenda kunokumbira ruregerero kuti muwane chokudya chamanhe…? [Congregation says, “chamanheru.”; Congregation laughs—ED] Haisi ngozi. Warumwa nechekudii…? [Congregation says, “nechekuchera.”] “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinotaura chii…? [Congregation says, ‘Mweya,’] Mweya kupiko?” [Congregation says, “kuKereke.”] Ndosaka kana une murume wako, rega kumudyisa. Ingomukurudzira kuti ade kunamata Mwari muMweya nemuyii…? [Congregation says, “nemuZvokwadi.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Mirai muchiona manje ma brother akashaya aya, ataive navo pano. Hamumborege kuona vana vavo kana vakura, vakabva pano vakanopinda mune dzimwe chechi idzi, kuti vana ava they will be confu…? [Congregation says, “confused.”] Vanenge vasina direction. Mukasangana nevana VaMlambo, you will not… you will not help but feel sorry. Ukasangana nevana VaMukodzi, you will not help but feel sorry.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Zvaitova nani, dai vakavasiya na—na—na Patson, uyu. Kwavari ikoko vanenge vatova mahure. Vapfanha kuputa mbanje. Kana mu South Africa mavanenge vari, vachiabhuyuzwa [being abused by—ED] nemadzisekuru. Hakusisina kwekuwira. Ha’maona zvazvinenge zvava? Vana ava vatoparara. Ende hakwana—hakuna role model yakanodzidzira chinhu kana chimwe chete. Kwatongova kuguma… Either kachaita …?... kuba mota. Kana kutengesa pfuti. Kana kugarira vanhu mumigwagwa kachiponda. “…vana vemapenzi!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapa hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: But iwewe uripo iwewe. Mwana, anogarwa naye pasi. Ndopaya patinoti, “Mwari ndiropafadzeyi, ndigone kuzonongedzera vana vangu kuzvinhu kwazvo.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka ma sister, hakuzi kungwara kuudzwa nambuya vako kuti dyisa murume. Hakuzi kungwara. Iwe unotora mupfuhwira uya uchidyisa murume, usingazive kuti kudyisa kwawaita murume waparadza imba yaani…? [Congregation says, “yako.”] Vana vako direction havasisi…? [Congregation says, “havasisina.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: But funga kana une murume akaita seni. Brother Gumbura. Vanoziva Shoko rose iri? Unofunga kuti ndicharegera Tito achiparara? [Congregation says, “no.”] Ndomudza kuti, “Iwe, gara apa mupfanha. Mira ndikuudze. Wisdom yose iri pano. Mwanangu, haudi n’anga. Haudi kurova guva. Haudi mudzimu. Ndoda kukutaurira kuti, how can you get rich? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] How can you be a dignified young man? Handikugezese nemushonga! Haurombe. Ndinoku trainer mupfanha. Mwari wandinonamata akandichengeta kusvika pandasvika nhasi!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Brother wafa, mwana wako anosara achiti, “Hah, baba vangu vai…?” Hamusati mamboona vanhu vari munyika, zvavanotaura kuti, “Baba vangu vandiudza kuti. Baba vangu …” Zvavanenge vachitaura ndezvehun’anga, kana zvemishonga, kana zvekumamisha, kana zvekuroya. “Baba vangu vakandidzidzisa kuti. Baba vangu vakati usadye chokupuhwa nemunhu. Baba vangu vakati usa truster shamwari. Baba vangu vakati kana ukaita ii…”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tuma wisdom twe—twekubhawa. Zvavaiudzana nemashamwari vachinwa chii…? [Congregation says, “doro,”] doro. But iwe wisdom yako inobva muShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] From the Ancient of Days. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vana vamuri kubereka imimi, without a shadow of doubt, vana ivavo vakaropafadzwa ka…? [Congregation says, “kare.”] Just by having a father anomira neShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Kunyangwe vakava vasikana, vanofa vasina kumbopfeka tight, kana kuburitsa guvhu out. Zvinofarirwa naMwa…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”] But, “vana vemapenzi,” maguvhu achabu…? [Congregation says, “achabuda.”] Ma trouser vachadii…? [Congregation says, “vachapfeka.”] Miromo vachadii…? [Congregation says, “vachapenda.”] Nzara vachaita sei? [Congregation says, “vachapenda.”] Nekuti baba vavo vakaramba kutungamirirwa naJeho…? [Congregation says, “naJehovha.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Esther akadzima… Shiphra akadzimara akaroorwa asina kumboisa cutex kumeso uyu. Aenda kumurume wake. Muchaonawo kuti Esther zvichaita futi the… [Congregation says, “the same.”] Haapfeke trouser. Haapfeke tight. Haapende zvigunwe. Achangoroorwa woitawo imba yake. Murikuona advantage yekuziva vabereki vanonamata? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka ana Esther vari vulnerable pama brother anenge angovati ngiri ngiri, because chanzi yemukomana womunyika chaiye hapa…? [Congregation says, “hapana,”] hapana! Haazive kunzi, “I love you,” ka uyu. Akawana mukana wemunhu wese anongomuti, “I love you, I love you Esther. When you sing, I will—I—I—I—I go jelly dropping.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Mashoko iwaya anoita like music in her ears. Haana kuzvijaira zvinhu zvakadaro. Anyone. Ndini ndinotozomuudza kuti, “Aiwa. Edgar mupfupi kwauri.” [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”; Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Handi’murikuona Shoko raMwari zvarinoita… eh. Vana vanenge vakachengetwa semazai. [Congregation laugh—ED] Handitika eh? Mukana wekubuda kunze uko vachinyengwa nenyika hava…? [Congregation says, “havana.”] Ha’maona? Moona. Ndosaka mukaona, kana ukaita baba vanonamata. Kana vapfanha vedu vana Tito vaya, they will never hava an opportunity yekunwa doro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hauvatende…? [Congregation says, “hauvatendere,”] hauvatendere. “Mupfanha, uchingomwa doro. Bhodhoro redoro, grounded. You won’t go to scho…? [Congregation says, “school.”] Toda kuona kuti shamwari dzako dziri kukutengera doro dzichakubhadharira here school fees next term?”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ende unonotaura—unotonotaura na headmaster. Woti, “Ndoda kuti chiregere term ino iyi. Ne inotevera yacho. Ndoda kuti chizodzokorora futi; i order yandiri kuisa mumba mangu. Shamwari ndinzwisisewo.” Chikange chatambura chiri kumba, “Baba handichanwa futi.” Woti, “Chidzokera.” Handi’murikuzviona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Eh! Chidzokera unoita zvinhu kwazvo.”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Unomuisira murawo, yekuti haafe akanwa doro, kana kuputa fodya, as long as you are ali…?[Congregation says, “alive.”] Eh. Vanotanga kutaura kuti, “Shamwari, iwe uri kunwa doro iwewe, nekuti mudhara ashaya? Mudhara akataura kuti pavana vake, anoputa fodya, akatukwa. Shamwarika? Hamheno zvako.” Vanotaurirana pacha…? [Congregation says, “pachavo.”] Ende vana ivavo unovasiyira gwara! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: “Baba vedu vakati usanyenge geri [girl—ED] friend yemunyi…? [Congregation says, “yemunyika.”] Usanyangana nemusikana anopenda muromo. Anokudyisa. Anogona kunge ane dzinza rehuroyi. Anogona kunge achibudirwa nedhimoni. Unoroora paKereke. Heh. Ende kana uchida vaviri kana vatatu, hazvina mhosva. As long as uchiroora pachena. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But zvauri kuita iweweka iwe, zvekuti uri kuenda uchiita sinjonjo mu Avenue umu. Iwe! Uchafa negwembe iwe!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Vanenge vachirairana pacha…? [Congregation says, “pachavo.”] This is The Right Of Fathers! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika Ameni ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah!”] Imi muri muno vanhu vaMwari imimi, uchibata mwana mumawoko kudai, muise mwana iyeye kunaMwari waani…? [Congregation says, “wako.”] Izouya ku dedication kuno uko, basa iroro wanguri wapedza ka…?[Congregation says, “kare.”] Uchibata mwana wako kudai, unofanira kukasimudza kudai, kuti, “Mwari, thank you for this boy. Ndazviona Baba kuti mune rudo neni. Muri kunditangira dzi…? [Congregation says, “dzinza.”] Ngaave Wenyu! Ndakupayi!”

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Seven days later, touya tomuisa muMawoko aShe. Wakuda simba rakanyanya rokusunga mwana uyu. “Vaviri venyu kana vatatu venyu vakabvumirana pachi…?” [Congregation says, “pachinhu.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But iwe u—achiuya mwana uyu, wakamupa kuna Jehovha ka…? [Congregation says, “kare.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzokunzwa ngavadii…? [Congregation says, ‘ngavanzwe,’] zvinotaura chii…? [Congregation says, ‘Mweya,’] Mweya kupiko?” [Congregation says, “kuKereke.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: I right yemunhu wese, kunyangwe ane mukondombera, unogona kuita mwana. Chobaiwa Varipa…? Haikona kuti, “Nokuti ndine mukondombera, ndofa ndisina.” Mai vane mukondombera nababa vane mukondombera, zvara. Itai chinhu chenyu chamunoisawo kuna Mwari. Iye mwana iyeye, AIDS, anenge asi…? [Congregation says, “asina.”] Eh, mosiya mamurongera. Kana uchiziva kuti iwe uri kufa, unobva waitawo vamwe brother vaunovimba chaizvo, nokuda nomwoyo wako we…? [Congregation says, “wese,”] wese. Uchitaura navo kuti mwana wako azokura ari pakati pemawoko aani? avo! Achitya Mwari.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Haikona kuti unofa usina mwana. Munhu haafe asina mwana! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Ameni varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Siyawo rudzi rwaani…? [Congregation says, “rwako.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatichipedzayi naJosefa, kuti Josefa aichengetwa nani? Verse 25. Hativerengeyi verse 25 tese: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost…

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Aah aah. Mapaona zvaataura? Hanzi, “Maropafadzo ababa vako, akunda vavengi vaani…?” [Congregation says, “vako.”] Ndo progenitors dziri kunyorwa apa. Handeyi mberi. …unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Ameni here akadarika Ameni? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndopatinoziva napo kuti Joseph haana kungoita Manasseh na Ephraim. Manasseh na Ephraim tinovaverengera chinhu one. Vakatorwa naJakobho zvikanzi ndevani…? [Congregation says, “ndevangu.”] But Josefa akazoita vana vakawanda chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Mu Ijipiti imo…? [Congregation says, “imomo.”] Vachikura imomo. But vakanga vatorwa ndi Manasseh na E…? [Congregation says, “na Ephraim.”] Ndovatinoramba tichiverenga kuBhaibhiri uku, tichiverenga ku Bhaibhiri uku.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Hanzi vaunozobereka kumashure kwa Manasseh na Ephraim ndevako. Apa Baba vake varikuti, “You shall be fruitful,” after varopafadza vakomana vaya vaya vaviri ka...? [Congregation says, “kare.”] Tingaite Amen here varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen Hallelujah. [Congregation says, “Amen, Hallelujah.”] Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen and Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka vana vaMwari. Tine chinonzi right yemadziba…? [Congregation says, “yemadzibaba.”] Ndeyedu iyoyo tinorongera vana vedu ramangwana. Tinovarongera mararamiro avanofanira kuita. Tinovarongera pfuma, madyiro, mapfekero, magariro, hanti’moona? Ndosaka iwewe neni tiri panapa iye zvino. Tirikunamatira ropafadzo kuti tiwane chekunongedzera vana vedu kwachiri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Tirikunamatira ropafadzo kuti tiwane chekunongedzera vana vedu kwachi…? [Congregation says, “kwachiri.”] Hanti’mukuzviona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiwane chatinosara tichiti ngatiunganirei pano. Tisare tichironga, hurongwa hwe Shoko raMwa…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Iwe ita zvakati, iwe ita zvakati. Ndosaka munhu wese kana achinamatira status. Nyaya ye status haiperi pakungoti ungova nechimiro muMwenga.

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Iva nechimiro kuvakadzi vako. Iva nechimiro kuvana vako. Iva nechimiro kuva nun’una vako, iva ne chimiro kunana baba vako. Iva nechimiro kuhama dzako. Nyaya iyi haisi diki hama, "A luta continua” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende zuva rimwe nerimwe tiriku weakener mweya yedzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zuva rimwe nerimwe tiriku draivha [to drive—ED] away the spirit of po…? [Congregation says, “poverty.”] Zuva rimwe nerimwe tirikuita grow from glory to…? [Congregation says, “glory.”] Zuva rimwe nerimwe tirikunyatso swedera padyo naMwa…? [Congregation says, “Mwari.”] Iti Baba ndiitirei nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba ndibatsireiwo manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba ndikundireiwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba ndiraramiseiwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda masimba anobva kwamuri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: A Father's Right (Part 2)
entries.text: Haikona kuramba uri muswe. “You shall always be the hear…?” [Congregation says, “heard.”] Wakadaidzwa kuti uropafadzwe.
